headline: There were over 9,000 Blockbusters in the US. Now there's one.
slides: Blockbuster's peak: more than 9,000 stores across the US.
One store, opened in 1992 as Pacific Video, became a Blockbuster franchise in 2000.
The last two in Alaska closed. Bend became the last Blockbuster in America.
A store in Perth, Australia closed. Bend became the last on Earth.
Its manager said it still ran the same computer system, floppy disks and all.
It's a tourist stop. You can still rent a movie there. Be kind, rewind.
sources: Sources: Oregon Encyclopedia, CBC, AP, New York Times (2018)
